question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Gaze
(Forest Guard)
options: Encounter
Obtain
Stare
Express
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Stare

Gaze - Stare

Explanation:
"Gaze" means to look steadily and intently, especially in admiration, surprise, or thought. "Stare" is the closest synonym as it also means to look fixedly at something.
(ग़ज़ का अर्थ है लगातार और गहराई से देखना, विशेष रूप से प्रशंसा, आश्चर्य या विचार में। "Stare" इसका सबसे करीबी समानार्थी है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी चीज़ को टकटकी लगाकर देखना है।)

Other synonyms Words:
Peer, Glare, Watch, Observe, Glimpse

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Gaze – टकटकी – (To look steadily and intently)
Example: "She continued to gaze at the stars in wonder."

Encounter – सामना करना – (To meet someone unexpectedly)
Example: "He encountered an old friend at the market."

Obtain – प्राप्त करना – (To get or acquire something)
Example: "She obtained permission to leave early."

Express – व्यक्त करना – (To convey a thought or feeling in words or actions)
Example: "He expressed his gratitude with a warm smile."

Stare – घूरना – (To look fixedly with wide-open eyes)
Example: "The child stared at the stranger in curiosity."

Conclusion:
"Stare" is the best synonym for "gaze" because both imply a fixed and intense way of looking. The other options do not relate to the act of looking.
("Stare" शब्द "gaze" का सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी है क्योंकि दोनों का अर्थ एक स्थिर और गहन दृष्टि से देखना है। अन्य विकल्प देखने की क्रिया से संबंधित नहीं हैं।)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Medicines should be ordered by the generic name, not by the proprietary or trade name.
(MTS Non technical and Havaldar Examination 2021)
options: Indidual
Exclusive
Specific
General
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: General

Medicines should be ordered by the generic name, not by the proprietary or trade name. - General

Explanation:
The word "generic" refers to something that is not specific to a brand but is common or general. "General" is the correct synonym as it conveys the idea of being non-specific or widely applicable.
"Generic" का अर्थ है सामान्य या बिना किसी विशेष ब्रांड के, इसलिए "General" सही पर्याय है।

Other synonyms Words:
Common, Universal, Standard, Broad, Non-specific

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Generic – सामान्य / जेनेरिक – Relating to a whole group or class; not specific to a brand.
Example: "Doctors often prescribe generic medicines to reduce costs."

Individual – व्यक्तिगत – Relating to a single person or thing; distinct.
Example: "Each individual has unique preferences."

Exclusive – विशेष / एकमात्र – Restricted to a particular group or person; not shared.
Example: "This club is exclusive to members only."

Specific – विशिष्ट – Clearly defined or identified; precise.
Example: "Please provide specific details about the issue."

General – सामान्य – Involving or affecting all or most people, things, or places; not specialized.
Example: "The general opinion was in favor of the new policy."

Conclusion:
"General" is the best synonym for "generic" because both words imply something common or non-specific, unlike "individual," "exclusive," or "specific," which suggest uniqueness or restriction.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Generosity

(Grade C Stenographers LDC Examination 2018 and 2019 )
options: Sophistication
Scarcity
Altruism
Idiosyncrasy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Altruism

Generosity - Altruism

Explanation:
Generosity refers to the quality of being kind and giving, often selflessly. Altruism is the closest synonym as it denotes selfless concern for the well-being of others.
[उदारता का अर्थ है दयालु और दानशील होने का गुण, अक्सर निस्वार्थ भाव से। परोपकार (Altruism) इसका सबसे निकटतम समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि यह दूसरों की भलाई के लिए निस्वार्थ चिंता को दर्शाता है।]

Other synonyms Words:
Benevolence, Magnanimity, Liberality, Philanthropy, Munificence

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Generosity – उदारता – The quality of being kind and giving.
Example: "Her generosity was evident when she donated a large sum to charity."

Sophistication – परिष्कार – The quality of being refined or cultured.
Example: "His sophistication was apparent in his choice of art and music."

Scarcity – अभाव – The state of being in short supply.
Example: "The scarcity of water in the region led to strict rationing."

Idiosyncrasy – विशिष्ट लक्षण – A peculiar or individual habit or characteristic.
Example: "One of his idiosyncrasies was always wearing mismatched socks."

Altruism – परोपकार – Selfless concern for the well-being of others.
Example: "His altruism was evident when he volunteered at the homeless shelter."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "Altruism" is the best synonym for "Generosity" because both words emphasize selfless concern and kindness toward others. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Generous
(Steno Typist)
options: Mild
Kind
Mean
Lazy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Kind

Generous - Kind

Explanation:
"Generous" means showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. "Kind" is a suitable synonym as it also implies a willingness to help others.
"उदार" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को, विशेष रूप से पैसे या समय को, आवश्यकता से अधिक देने की इच्छा रखना। "दयालु" एक उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह भी दूसरों की मदद करने की इच्छा को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Benevolent, Charitable, Liberal, Magnanimous, Philanthropic

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Generous – उदार – Willing to give and share freely.
Example: "She was generous enough to donate a large sum to charity."

Mild – हल्का – Gentle or not harsh.
Example: "He has a mild temperament."

Mean – कंजूस – Unwilling to give or share.
Example: "He was too mean to donate even a small amount."

Lazy – आलसी – Unwilling to work or use energy.
Example: "She was too lazy to complete her assignments."

Kind – दयालु – Having a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
Example: "He was kind enough to help the old lady cross the road."

Conclusion:
"Kind" is the best synonym for "Generous" as both words reflect a willingness to help and give. The other options either do not convey the same meaning or have negative connotations.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.Genesis
(SICPO 2024 Paper II)
options:
Conclusion

Symbolism

Infatuation

Inception
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Inception

Genesis - Inception

Explanation:
'Genesis' refers to the origin or beginning of something, and 'Inception' also means the starting point or creation of something. Both words denote the initial stage or birth of an idea, process, or entity.
'Genesis' और 'Inception' दोनों का अर्थ किसी चीज की शुरुआत या उत्पत्ति से है।

Other synonyms Words:
Origin, Beginning, Commencement, Dawn, Outset

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Genesis – उत्पत्ति – The origin or mode of formation of something.
Example: 'The book explores the genesis of the universe.'

Conclusion – निष्कर्ष – The end or finish of an event or process.
Example: 'The conclusion of the meeting was unexpected.'

Symbolism – प्रतीकवाद – The use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.
Example: 'The novel is rich in religious symbolism.'

Infatuation – मोह – An intense but short-lived passion or admiration.
Example: 'His infatuation with her faded quickly.'

Inception – शुरुआत – The establishment or starting point of an institution or activity.
Example: 'The project has been successful since its inception.'

Conclusion:
'Inception' is the best synonym for 'Genesis' because both words refer to the beginning or origin of something, while the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

Genial

options: Optimistic
Positive
Cheerful
Despondent
solution:

Genial - Cheerful

Explanation:
"Genial" means friendly and cheerful, which aligns perfectly with "Cheerful." Both words convey a warm and pleasant demeanor.

Example: "After the failure, he became despondent and withdrawn."

Cheerful – हर्षित, प्रसन्न – Noticeably happy and optimistic.

question:

Gentle
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2023)
options: Ferocious
Fierce
Sympathetic
Cruel
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Sympathetic

Gentle - Sympathetic

Explanation:
"Gentle" refers to someone who is kind, tender, or mild in nature, and "sympathetic" aligns closely with this meaning as it describes someone who shows care and understanding.
"Gentle" का अर्थ है कोमल या दयालु, और "sympathetic" इसी भावना से मेल खाता है क्योंकि यह किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो समझदारी और संवेदना दिखाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Kind, Tender, Mild, Compassionate, Soft

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Gentle – कोमल – (Kind or mild in temperament)
Example: "She spoke in a gentle voice to calm the child."

Ferocious – क्रूर – (Savagely fierce or violent)
Example: "The ferocious lion attacked its prey."

Fierce – उग्र – (Showing a violent or aggressive nature)
Example: "The fierce storm caused heavy damage."

Cruel – निर्दयी – (Willfully causing pain or suffering)
Example: "The cruel king punished his subjects harshly."

Sympathetic – सहानुभूतिशील – (Showing care and understanding for others)
Example: "The teacher was sympathetic towards the struggling student."

Conclusion:
"Sympathetic" is the best synonym for "gentle" among the given options because both words convey kindness and understanding, whereas the other options (ferocious, fierce, cruel) represent harsh or aggressive qualities.

solution:

"Glance" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ पर जल्दी या संक्षिप्त नज़र डालना, और "glimpse" भी किसी चीज़ को संक्षिप्त रूप से देखने को दर्शाता है। दोनों शब्दों का तात्पर्य एक छोटा और अक्सर अधूरा दृश्य होता है।

Example: "She gave a quick glance at her watch."

Example: "A flash of lightning lit up the sky."

Stare – घूरना – To look fixedly or intently
Example: "He stared at the painting for hours."

Gaze – टकटकी लगाकर देखना – To look steadily and intently
Example: "She gazed at the stars in wonder."

Glimpse – झलक – A brief or incomplete view

solution:

Other synonyms Words:
Connoisseur, Foodie, Gastronome, Gourmand, Bon vivant

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Gourmet – भोजन-प्रेमी – A connoisseur of good food; a person with a discerning palate.
Example: "He is a gourmet who travels the world to taste authentic cuisines."

Non-indulgent – संयमी – Not allowing oneself or others to enjoy pleasures, especially food and drink.
Example: "She follows a non-indulgent diet, avoiding rich foods."

Indifferent – उदासीन – Having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.
Example: "He was indifferent to the gourmet dishes served at the party."

Detached – अलग – Emotionally uninvolved or disconnected.
Example: "She remained detached from the culinary discussions."

Epicure – रसिक – A person who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink.
Example: "As an epicure, he spends hours selecting the perfect wine for dinner."

Conclusion:
"Epicure" is the best synonym for "gourmet" because both refer to someone who appreciates and enjoys high-quality food and drink. The other options do not convey the same meaning of refined culinary taste.

offer – पेशकश करना – To present something for acceptance or rejection.
Example: "She decided to offer him a job."

free – मुक्त करना – To release from confinement or restraint.

Example: "The police seized the illegal goods."

"Seize" is the best synonym for "grab" because both imply taking hold of something quickly or forcibly, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.
